Developer FAQ

Differentiation, financial rails, integration, retention, veto mechanics, and key operations.

How is SentinelGate fundamentally different from standard LLM gateways?

Standard gateways only provide telemetry, caching, and brittle regex or secondary LLM guardrails that add latency and are easily jailbroken. SentinelGate is an active cryptographic defense layer. It evaluates prompts against thermodynamic kinematic phase boundaries in-memory, severing execution at Token 0 when instability is detected, and stamps every transaction with a verifiable Ed25519 attestation proof.

Is SentinelGate compatible with financial messaging standards like ISO 20022?

Yes. Autonomous AI agents processing financial transactions, payment approvals, or automated credit actions require strict non-repudiation and tamper-evident audit trails. Every transaction passing through SentinelGate produces a canonical Ed25519-signed evidence bag (including thermodynamic coordinates, process identifiers, and cryptographic hashes) designed to map directly into ISO 20022 Supplementary Data (SplmtryData) envelopes.

How do I integrate SentinelGate with my existing code?

It requires a single line of configuration. SentinelGate is fully wire-compatible with the official OpenAI SDK. Simply update your client's base_url to https://api.sentinelgate.dev/v1 and pass your sk-sent-... API key. Prompts, schemas, streaming, and tool calls work out of the box with zero code refactoring.

Does SentinelGate store or log prompt payloads?

No. SentinelGate maintains a strict zero-retention architecture. Prompts are evaluated in-memory against kinematic boundary states, forwarded directly to GPT-4o, and evicted from memory upon socket termination. Only cryptographic attestation hashes, Ed25519 signatures, and billing counters are committed to the PostgreSQL ledger.

What is the latency overhead of the Kinematic Security Veto?

Stage I Kinematic evaluations run in-memory with sub-millisecond computation time prior to upstream dispatch. Overall proxy routing latency is typically under 15ms—negligible compared to the standard latency variance of upstream LLM inference.

What happens when an adversarial prompt triggers a Veto?

The proxy halts generation immediately at Token 0, issues an HTTP 403 kinematic_security_veto, and drops the socket before upstream tokens are consumed. The client receives an Ed25519-signed evidence bag detailing the thermodynamic state coordinates and attestation hash for audit logging.

How does key provisioning work after checkout?

Immediately upon completing Stripe checkout, you are redirected to a secure, one-time reveal page where your secret key is displayed. Once rendered or copied, the raw secret is permanently purged from our database—we store only a salted SHA-256 hash.

How do I rotate an API key or request developer support?

If you ever misplace an API key or suspect an environment leak, contact [email protected]. We execute an immediate multi-cluster credential revocation and mint a secure 24-hour one-time re-claim token.

Simply update your client's base_url to https://api.sentinelgate.dev/v1 and pass your sk-sent-... API key. Prompts, schemas, streaming, and tool calls work out of the box with zero code refactoring.
